items.name: emoji-picker
items.title: Emoji Picker
items.description: A Frimousse emoji picker with Emojisense search: on-device alias ranking on every keystroke, then semantic results from precomputed shards or the API when the dictionary is unsure.
items.docs: Load the packs once with `useEmojisense({ packBaseUrl, shardsUrl, endpoint })` from `@emojisense/react`, then compose `<EmojiPicker emojisense={sense}>` with `<EmojiPickerSearch />`, `<EmojiPickerContent />` and `<EmojiPickerFooter />`. Omit `shardsUrl` and `endpoint` for fully offline search. Pass `emojiSet: "twemoji" | "noto" | "fluent"` (with `endpoint`) to draw hosted emoji images instead of the system font.
